mapper.sql: id, refund_no, source_type, source_id, merchant_id, refund_amount, status, reason, payout_status, del_flag, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: select id from mms_merchant where id = #{merchantId} and member_id = #{ownerMemberId} and status = 1 and account_status = 1 and del_flag = 0 for update
select from refund_application r where r.id = #{refundId} and and r.del_flag = 0 limit 1
select from refund_application r where r.id = #{refundId} and and r.del_flag = 0 for update

select reg.refund_policy_code, reg.refund_policy_version, reg.refund_deadline from refund_application r inner join cms_registration reg on reg.id = r.source_id where r.id = #{refundId} and and r.source_type = 'registration' and r.del_flag = 0 limit 1
mapper.sql: case when r.source_type = 'registration' then ( select nullif(coalesce( nullif(case reg.owner_type when 2 then (select a.name from cms_activity a where a.id = reg.owner_id) when 1 then (select t.name from cms_topic t where t.id = reg.owner_id) end, ''), reg.activity_title), '') from cms_registration reg where reg.id = r.source_id ) end as activity_title, (select nullif(u.nickname, '') from ums_member u where u.id = r.member_id and u.del_flag = 0) as customer_nickname, r.platform_takeover_at
mapper.select: select r.id, from refund_application r where r.id = #{refundId} and and r.del_flag = 0 limit 1

choose.when: and r.status = 0 and latest.latest_opinion_id is null
and ((r.status = 0 and latest.latest_opinion_id is not null) or (r.status = 1 and (r.payout_status is null or r.payout_status not in (1, 4))))

mapper.select:
select r.id, r.refund_no, r.source_type, r.source_id, r.refund_amount, r.status, r.reason, r.payout_status, r.create_time, coalesce(opinion.decision, 'PENDING') as merchant_opinion,
from refund_application r
where and r.del_flag = 0
order by r.create_time desc, r.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}

select count(1) from refund_application r
where and r.del_flag = 0

select id, refund_application_id, merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, decision, content, evidence_url, request_id, create_time from merchant_aftercare_response where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and refund_application_id = #{refundId} and decision in ('AGREE', 'REJECT') order by id desc limit 1

select id, refund_application_id, merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, decision, content, evidence_url, request_id, create_time from merchant_aftercare_response where merchant_id = #{merchantId} and request_id = #{requestId} limit 1 for update
mapper.insert: insert into merchant_aftercare_response (refund_application_id, merchant_id, merchant_owner_member_id, actor_member_id, actor_role_code, decision, content, evidence_url, request_id, create_time) values (#{refundApplicationId}, #{merchantId}, #{merchantOwnerMemberId}, #{actorMemberId}, #{actorRoleCode}, #{decision}, #{content}, #{evidenceUrl}, #{requestId}, #{createTime})
